summary: Practise collateral, guarantee and residual-risk reviews using Basel Framework concepts. Explore the five-day course and build usable credit file outputs.
lede: Credit risk mitigation uses collateral, guarantees and other protections to reduce a lender’s potential loss when a borrower defaults. For credit officers, collateral specialists and portfolio risk teams, the course develops practical skills in haircut-adjusted collateral analysis, guarantee assessment and residual-risk monitoring. Learners also review eligibility evidence, documentation and concentration concerns, then use sample records to support lending decisions and portfolio reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who select, document, review or report protections against borrower default across lending portfolios.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of lending or credit review processes is recommended. No programming is required; practical calculations use Excel. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for the workbook exercises.
